notes: *confession is made* heads on *confession*, the word realizing the ὁμολογ- lexeme, rather than on the light verb or its auxiliary (rules 17, 91).
The two anarthrous datives καρδίᾳ and στόματι are parsed alike, each carrying both its case preposition and its supplied determiner with no article standing (rules 21, 24, 51).
The supplied generic subject *man* completes the impersonal passive's own English and is a rule 7 helper on it, not an added word under rule 103.
